name: Juvederm Volbella

lead: Volbella is a low-concentration hyaluronic acid filler used for subtle lip fullness, fine lines around the mouth and the hollow under the eyes. People choose it for smoother lips and a less tired look, with the change visible straight away.

A lightly cross-linked HA gel made with Vycross technology is placed superficially to add soft volume and smooth fine lines, then degrades over time. Randomized and open-label trials report improved lip fullness out to 12 months, and trials in under-eye hollowing have been run in the US and China.

paras: A licensed clinician injects the lips or under-eye area in an office visit, often with lidocaine in the XC version. People repeat treatments as the gel absorbs, and results can be dissolved with hyaluronidase.

Reported effects include swelling and bruising. Delayed reactions in the tear-trough area and lips have been published, including a retrospective report of recurrent reactions. It is a prescription medical device.

chain: Fine HA gel adds soft volume
angle.text: Volbella is a fine hyaluronic acid filler used for subtle lip definition and to soften the under-eye hollow, with the change visible straight away. The soft gel adds light volume in delicate areas. Randomized trials report lip improvement to 12 months.

lead: Juvéderm Volbella (VYC-15L; Volbella XC with lidocaine) is a low-concentration cross-linked hyaluronic acid (HA) filler from Allergan, made with Vycross technology and used for fine lines and delicate areas, chiefly the lips and perioral region and the under-eye hollow (infraorbital) area. [1][2]

Randomized and open-label trials report improvement in lip fullness out to 12 months, and trials in infraorbital hollowing have been run in the US and China. [1][3][4] Reports of delayed reactions in the tear-trough area and lips have also been published. [5]

paras: The product is a 15 mg/mL HA gel formulated with Vycross technology; a postmarket lip study used the lidocaine version. [2] Laboratory comparisons of seven cross-linking technologies tested properties such as cohesivity and resistance to compression across HA gels. [6] A review discusses Voluma, Volift and Volbella together as a Vycross range suited to different depths and areas. [7]
Lip and perioral enhancement and infraorbital hollowing are the main studied uses. [1][3][4][8]

A retrospective study of 400 patients reported that a newly introduced filler in the tear-trough area and lips was associated with a higher rate of late reactions, with persistent and recurrent courses, than the 0.02% rate recorded for HA fillers generally. [5]

A 12-month multicenter open-label study of 60 subjects treated the perioral area and used a lip fullness responder endpoint. [1] A postmarket study of 62 subjects evaluated aesthetic impact in the lips. [2] Randomized, controlled studies followed lip and perioral enhancement for 12 months. [3][9][10] A repeat-treatment study examined retreatment safety. [11] An open-label study evaluated infraorbital skin depressions. [4]
Registered trials include lip comparisons with Restylane-L (n=285), a lip study with 225 participants and Chinese lip (n=176) and infraorbital (n=160) studies. [12][13][14][15]
